notes: TRAP CHECK: the PEPLIFE2 header lists T1/2a values of 3.2 h (GLP1_8G37C-HSA) and 3.3 h (GLP1_8A37C-HSA). No alpha/distribution-phase half-life appears anywhere in the body of this article; the body reports only the terminal plasma half-lives (9.0 h and 7.1 h). The 3.2/3.3 h values are database metadata and were therefore NOT extracted. PK was measured for only two of the four GLP1-HSA conjugates (GLP1_8G37C-HSA and GLP1_8A37C-HSA); GLP1_8G37AzF-HSA was only speculated to be comparable and GLP1_8G16AzF-HSA half-life values are citations of prior work. Group size discrepancy: Methods 2.8 states six IPGTT groups of n = 6/group, whereas the Figure 7 caption states n = 3/group; both are recorded. No Cmax, tmax or concentration-time AUC is reported anywhere in the body; the AUC in Figure 7B is a blood-glucose AUC from the IPGTT, not a PK exposure metric. Amino acid sequences of the GLP-1 variants are referenced in the Figure 2A caption but the one-letter sequences are not printed in the body text, so all sequences are recorded as 'not reported'. Curation rule applied: procedural challenge/probe substances (intraperitoneal glucose, 1.5 g/kg, used for the IPGTT; TCO-Cy5.5 dye used for in-gel labelling) are documented here rather than listed as agents, because they are assay reagents rather than test articles and the role enum has no category for them. Serum samples were assayed by ELISA as bioanalysis of in vivo samples; this was not classified as an ex vivo study type.
